column1: # local is the one verdict whose SECOND column names a Go struct rather
# than a schema, and whose API column is therefore `-`. It is what makes
# the set of compared types part of the rule: the gate walks the wire
# package as well as the snapshot, so a type renamed out of the way fails
# here instead of quietly dropping out of the comparison.
# The Sheets API is far larger than this server's surface, and that is a
# decision rather than an omission. What this record adds is that the
# decision is per field: a field Google adds to a type this server models
# fails the build until somebody says which heading below it joins.
# An out row says what is out, which is not the same as what the server
# cannot do. The first draft of this file got that wrong three times over
# — it wrote off Connected Sheets, developer metadata and dimension
# groups as features "no tool reaches", when manage_data_source,
# manage_anchor and edit_dimensions are built on all three. The check
# behind those claims was grep for the JSON property name in quotes, and
# this repo builds requests from typed Go structs, so the name never
# appears as a literal and the grep could only ever find map-based
# builders. Read the Go identifier, not the wire name.

column5: reason
